statement: An exact G2 board-fiber isomorphism transports the complete abstract ordinary-value algebra: q states, legal actions, exact strong action/state values, best-move sets, and strong-score threshold boundaries.

premises: A G2 fiber isomorphism bijects future cells and residual hyperedges.
It preserves gravity/frontier legality and therefore bijects legal actions.
It transports owner-true and owner-false principal cofactors exactly.
The induced child mapping is again a G2 fiber isomorphism.
Strong-score semantics depend only on terminal kind, remaining-ply distance, child value, and max over legal actions.
theorem_candidate.induction: Induct on number of remaining cells. Corresponding terminal actions have equal strong scores. Corresponding nonterminal actions map to isomorphic child q states and therefore equal child values by the induction hypothesis; one-ply lift preserves equality. Max over the action bijection preserves state value and maps the argmax set. Since the q-state mapping is an order isomorphism, every Upper/Lower threshold boundary transports exactly.
theorem_candidate.conclusion: G2 structural fiber isomorphism implies isomorphism of the complete abstract ordinary strong-value boundary algebra.

guards: This is an abstract ordinary-value fiber-algebra result.
It does not assert that the historical/physical legal-q realization subset at one support maps onto the legal-q realization subset at another embedding.
It does not identify proof/certificate provenance or past ownership history.
Use for exact value-boundary reuse relies on the conservative-extension property for legal q states.
It does not establish that the board-fiber quotient is minimal or that root-scale representation is compact.
interpretation: G3 survives all executed non-reflection value-transport tests.
Given G2, G3 is theorem-shaped rather than merely empirical: value semantics are functorial under the board-fiber isomorphism.
Concrete board embedding is irrelevant to the abstract ordinary-value RBA fiber once the support-conditioned residual-incidence/gravity fiber is fixed.
The board geometry can therefore be factored before the value algebra by quotienting supports to exact structural fiber types.
